summary.en: Former President Joseph Kabila has formally joined the M23 rebels and now leads a broader anti-government coalition fighting the Congolese army in North Kivu. Security personnel linked to Erik Prince were ambushed, resulting in the death of a former New Zealand special forces officer and wounds to former UFC fighter Tim Kennedy. The coalition expands the rebel alliance beyond M23 alone. The conflict remains deadly, with 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Tidligere president Joseph Kabila har formelt sluttet seg til M23-opprørerne og leder nå en bredere anti-regjeringskoalisjon som kjemper mot den congolesiske hæren i Nord-Kivu. Sikkerhetspersonell knyttet til Erik Prince ble overfalt, noe som førte til at en tidligere nyzealandsk spesialstyrkeoffiser døde og den tidligere UFC-utøveren Tim Kennedy ble såret. Koalisjonen utvider opprørsalliansen utover kun M23. Konflikten forblir dødelig, med 1 158 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: M23 campaign (2022–present)
background.extract: The M23 campaign is an ongoing series of military offensives launched by the March 23 Movement (M23), a Rwandan-backed rebel paramilitary group in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, since March 2022. In November 2021, M23 first launched attacks against the Congolese military (FARDC) and MONUSCO, seizing military positions in Ndiza, Cyanzu, and Runyoni in North Kivu Province. This coincided with the deployment of Uganda People's Defence Force (UPDF) to the region to combat the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF), a Ugandan rebel group operating in the Congo's North Kivu and Ituri provinces.
